children.text: A habit tracker for students: today’s list, streaks and a weekly review

children.name: Agent’s answer
children.text: I drew Today, the screen you open the app on, and chose a look from your request: calm, for students. Green on warm white, Figtree, soft corners and outline icons. It is written down in the Design system, with the reasons; every page after this one uses it.
Describe a change, or type / for commands…
